messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — I'm finalizing the v2.3.0 draft release now. Please do a quick sanity on annotated tag + uploaded assets. If anything looks off (checksums, missing wheels, unsigned artifacts) can someone republish?

ben: on it, will verify checksums for wheel + docker. ETA ~10m. :hourglass:

elaine: I can re-upload the signed wheel if needed. Which bucket/artifact name should I check?

marta: thanks — wheel is packages/redwood-inference-2.3.0-py3-none-any.whl and docker tag is ghcr.io/redwood/inference:2.3.0. CI uploaded both to the release draft.

raj: saw a checksum variance on the wheel when I tested locally — downloading now to confirm. Could be a flaky CI runner that re-built without deterministic flags.

ben: confirmed the wheel checksum differs from the manifest in the draft release assets. Docker image digest matches.

marta: ok, let's avoid breaking downloads. Plan: elaine re-uploads signed wheel (gpg detached) and I will update the draft assets with the new checksum. Then we re-run the release checksum validation job.

elaine: copying the upload steps here:```bash
# rebuild wheel (if needed)
python -m build -w
# sign
gpg --armor --detach-sign dist/redwood_inference-2.3.0-py3-none-any.whl
# upload to GH release (using gh cli)
gh release upload v2.3.0 dist/* --clobber
```

marta: perfect. When you upload, tag me in the thread and I'll kick the validation job. Also small changelog nudge: please confirm we kept the "perf: reduce cold-start by reusing KV cache across warmups" bullet — I want that exact phrasing in the annotated tag message.

elaine: uploaded signed wheel and pushed with --clobber. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-assets/asset/12345  :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Validation job started for v2.3.0 (job id 4812). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/4812

raj: running checksum verifier now against the GH asset URL.

ben: also sanity-checked the release notes body — annotate tag should include minimal migration note about breaking config key rename. Example message I recommended: "v2.3.0 — annotated: perf fixes; config: rename 'inference.batch_size' -> 'inference.max_batch' (auto-mapped)"

marta: yeah include that. Keep it short. I'll create the annotated tag with that text. Command I'll run:```bash
git tag -a v2.3.0 -m "v2.3.0 — perf fixes; config rename: inference.batch_size -> inference.max_batch (auto-mapped)"
git push origin v2.3.0
```

raj: verifier finished — checksums match now. :tada:

ben: CI validation job passed (4812). No stale assets.

marta: awesome. Final question: cutoff confirmation — are we good to call the branch frozen for release prep? If anyone needs a last-minute patch, please file a cherry-pick PR and ping here in the next 15m.

elaine: nothing else from SDK side.

raj: approved.

ben: ok from infra.

marta: cool — freezing branch in 10m. I'll post final go/no-go once I tag for real. Thanks all. :rocket:
